warnings: *** REWRITTEN AFTER A-13 WAS READ - THE FIXTURE NUMBERS ARE NOW RESOLVED. *** This file first recorded 3 fittings by their circled digit alone with fixture_type_not_resolved, because neither A-11 nor A-12 prints a legend. A-13 (หน้า14) carries รายละเอียดสุขภัณฑ์ห้องน้ำ, a ten-row table keying every digit. Those entries have been renamed to the scheduled fixture and their flags cleared; the printed digit is kept in printed_as and the source of the name is stated on each element. The earlier reading is recorded here rather than deleted, per the append-or-rewrite rule - it is the honest record that this sheet alone could not identify them.
THE GRANITE WALL PANEL HEIGHT IS PRINTED ONLY HERE: TOP หินแกรนิต สูง 1.20 ม. A-11's section shows the same panel but gives no height, so this is the sheet that carries it.
SAME ระดับฝ้าเพดาน 2.60 ม. AS ห้องน้ำ 1, written the same way without a plus sign, and read the same way - a height above the room floor, not an absolute level. See A-11's section warning.

The section chains read 0.50 + 0.50 + 0.20 + 0.40 + 0.80 across, with 1.70 and 0.80 as sub-totals, and 0.60 / 1.45 / 2.05 up the right-hand side - the same tiling and fitting heights as ห้องน้ำ 1, which is consistent with two bathrooms built to one standard.
